text: Suddenly there came into view. <break time="0.8s" /> A decrepit old man. <break time="0.8s" /> Of some sixty five or seventy years. <break time="0.8s" /> Whose countenance at once arrested. <break time="0.8s" /> And absorbed my whole attention. <break time="0.8s" /> On account of its absolute strangeness. <break time="0.8s" /> Never before had I seen anything. <break time="0.8s" /> Even remotely resembling that expression. <break time="0.8s" /> And as I tried to analyze it. <break time="0.8s" /> A crowd of contradictory ideas. <break time="0.8s" /> Arose confusedly in my mind. <break time="0.8s" /> Ideas of vast mental power. <break time="0.8s" /> Of caution and avarice. <break time="0.8s" /> Of coolness and malice. <break time="0.8s" /> Of triumph and merriment. <break time="0.8s" /> Of excessive terror. <break time="0.8s" /> And of intense, supreme despair. <break time="0.8s" /> All seemed written upon that single face. <break time="0.8s" /> How wild a history. <break time="0.8s" /> I said to myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Is written within that bosom. <break time="0.8s" /> And I felt a craving desire. <break time="0.8s" /> To keep the man in view. <break time="0.8s" /> To know more of him. <break time="0.8s" /> Hurriedly putting on my overcoat. <break time="0.8s" /> And seizing my hat and cane. <break time="0.8s" /> I made my way into the street. <break time="0.8s" /> And pushed through the crowd. <break time="0.8s" /> In the direction he had taken. <break time="0.8s" /> For he had already disappeared. <break time="0.8s" /> With some little difficulty. <break time="0.8s" /> I at length came within sight of him. <break time="0.8s" /> And I followed closely yet cautiously. <break time="0.8s" /> So as not to attract the attention. <break time="0.8s" /> Of this strange and restless figure. <break time="0.8s" /> He was short in stature. <break time="0.8s" /> Very thin, and apparently very feeble. <break time="0.8s" /> And his clothes were filthy and ragged. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet the linen he wore. <break time="0.8s" /> Though dirty. <break time="0.8s" /> Was of beautiful texture. <break time="0.8s" /> Through a rent. <break time="0.8s" /> In his closely buttoned cloak. <break time="0.8s" /> I caught a glimpse. <break time="0.8s" /> Both of a diamond and of a dagger. <break time="0.8s" /> A discovery which only heightened my curiosity. <break time="0.8s" /> And made me resolve. <break time="0.8s" /> To follow him wherever he went.
